# FOX 11 Los Angeles

> > FOX 11 Los Angeles delivers breaking news, investigations, and in-depth coverage of Southern California communities including Los Angeles County, Long Beach, San Bernardino County, and surrounding areas.

FOX 11 Los Angeles (FOXLA.com) is a leading local news source providing comprehensive coverage of breaking news, politics, crime, weather, and community stories across the greater Los Angeles metropolitan area. The station reports on major institutions including LAUSD, LAPD, LAFD, and local government while covering everything from wildfires and natural disasters to cultural events and civic issues affecting Southern California residents.

## Key Topics

- Los Angeles
- California
- Los Angeles County
- Southern California
- LAFD (Los Angeles Fire Department)
- LAPD (Los Angeles Police Department)
- LAUSD (Los Angeles Unified School District)
- San Bernardino County
- Long Beach
- Breaking news and emergencies
- Wildfires and natural disasters
- Local politics and government
- Crime and public safety
- Civil rights and social justice
